purpose: Track progress and scores for games played by kids.

progressId.description: Unique identifier for the progress record.

kidId.description: ID of the kid who played the game.

duration.description: Time spent playing the game (in seconds).

playedAt.description: Timestamp when the game was played.

createdAt.description: Timestamp when the progress record was created.

updatedAt.description: Timestamp when the progress record was last updated.

access_patterns.teacher: read if linked to their student
access_patterns.parent: read if linked to their child

composite_indexes_needed.description: For querying progress by kid and game.
For querying progress by game and date.

validation_rules: score must be a non-negative number.
level must be a non-negative number.
duration must be a non-negative number.
performance_notes: Indexes on kidId and gameId are critical for progress queries.
